svg.aria-label: A classic Mac desktop. An About Shrivas window: Shrivas VM, founder and creative director of ENTØ Studios, Dundee, Scotland, with a 1-bit portrait. Desktop icons for Gotham, The Daily Bugle, ENTØ Studios, Vidyuth Nº12, Shrivas PS and Sujitha M. An alert says Gotham is live.
